title: Marketplace premium tax credits - income basics
facts: Marketplace premium tax credit eligibility and amount depend on household information, expected annual income and other eligibility rules.
Marketplace savings are based on expected household income for the coverage year, not simply last year's income.

People receiving advance premium tax credits should update Marketplace applications when expected income or household circumstances change to reduce the risk of receiving the wrong amount of advance credit.
The federal income-tax reconciliation process uses Form 1095-A and Form 8962 under applicable IRS rules.
